title: Cranial decompression for ischaemic stroke in Germany, 2019-2024: code and extracted aggregate counts
description: Code and extracted aggregate counts for a descriptive study of cranial decompression (OPS 5-012.0) with a primary diagnosis of cerebral infarction (ICD-10-GM I63) in Germany, 2019 to 2024, using nationwide inpatient billing data published in the InEK DatenBrowser. The repository reproduces the age distribution, age-specific utilisation relative to all primary-I63 inpatient episodes and to those with coded cerebral oedema or brain compression, in-hospital mortality by age band, discharge disposition by year and age, reperfusion treatment coded in the same episode, and temporal trends. No individual-level data are included.
